data.one_liner: Offline whisper.cpp bindings for speech-to-text, translation, and VAD in Flutter
data.what_it_does: Provides native Android and iOS bindings for whisper.cpp, allowing offline transcription, translation, microphone streaming, and voice activity detection. Audio remains completely on the device after model download.
use_when: You need private, completely offline speech-to-text transcription on mobile devices.
You want to process audio files or microphone live streams using whisper.cpp models.
avoid_when: You need to support web, macOS, Windows, or Linux desktop platforms.
You cannot afford the storage and processing overhead of local GGML machine learning models.
strengths: Fully offline and private operation without external server dependencies.
Supports live microphone streaming, WAV file processing, and Silero VAD.
weaknesses: Limited to Android and iOS platforms.
Requires managing large external model files.
data.setup_notes: Requires RECORD_AUDIO permission on Android and microphone usage description in Info.plist on iOS. Models must be downloaded separately.
